title: Oracle-interacting simulation program
statement: For a Boolean-symbol finite-tape Turing machine $M$, define a program with $k+1$ work tapes, two possible deciders, and states paired with simulation phases. Its initial state is $(q_0,\\mathrm{ask})$, where $q_0$ is the initial state of $M$; its ordinary transition function is the simulation transition function, and its call function is the oracle call specification described by the phase.
